title: Itinerary UI Component Catalog
description: JSON Schema catalog defining all available UI components in the itinerary planning system, including layout, display, and interactive components.

CommonComponentProperties.description: Properties shared by all components in the catalog.

id.description: Unique identifier for the component instance within the surface tree.

component.description: Component type name, must match one of the defined component names in this catalog.

weight.description: Rendering priority and ordering weight. Lower values render first. Used for layout ordering within containers.

Card.description: A container card component that wraps a single child component with border styling, background, and padding.

childId.description: The id of the child component rendered inside this card.

borderStyle.description: CSS border style applied to the card.

background.description: Background color or gradient CSS value for the card.

padding.description: Padding in pixels applied inside the card.

borderRadius.description: Border radius in pixels for rounded corners.

shadow.description: CSS box-shadow value for the card elevation.

Column.description: A vertical flex layout container that arranges children in a column.

children.description: Ordered list of child component IDs to render in the column.

alignment.description: Horizontal alignment of children within the column.

Row.description: A horizontal flex layout container that arranges children in a row.

children.description: Ordered list of child component IDs to render in the row.

alignment.description: Vertical alignment of children within the row.

wrap.description: Whether children should wrap to the next line when overflowing.

List.description: A scrollable list container that renders children using a repeated template pattern.

childrenTemplate.description: The component ID or type name used as the template for each list item.

dataSource.description: Array of data objects, each mapped to the childrenTemplate to produce list items.

itemSpacing.description: Spacing between list items in pixels.

showScrollbar.description: Whether to show the scrollbar indicator.

keyExtractor.description: Field name in dataSource items used as the unique key for each list item.

ActivityCard.description: Displays a single activity item with rich metadata including image, rating, tags, and interactive actions. Supports visual variants for different trip contexts.

description.description: Detailed description explaining why this activity is included in the plan.

imageUrl.description: URL of the activity's cover image.

rating.description: Activity rating score, typically on a 5-point scale.

tags.description: Contextual tags describing the activity (e.g., '真实地点', '可执行', '网红打卡').

timeLine.description: Scheduled time slot for the activity, e.g., '14:30-16:30'.

variant.description: Visual and behavioral variant based on trip context.

isSelected.description: Whether the activity is currently selected by the user.

isBooked.description: Whether the activity has been booked/confirmed.

isEmphasized.description: Whether the activity should be visually highlighted based on UI strategy.

travelTime.description: Travel time in minutes from the previous activity to this one.

draggable.description: Whether the activity card can be dragged to reorder.

index.description: Zero-based position index of this activity in the itinerary.

reasoning.description: AI reasoning for why this activity was chosen.

teamFit.description: Explanation of how this activity fits the team or individual preferences.

RouteOverview.description: Displays a summary overview of the planned route including total distance, duration, cost, and travel mode selection.

totalDuration.description: Total estimated travel duration in minutes.

totalCost.description: Total estimated cost of transportation in RMB.

activityCount.description: Number of activities included in the route.

travelMode.description: Selected transportation mode for the route.

availableModes.description: List of available travel modes the user can switch between.

routeHeadline.description: Headline summary text for the route.

title.description: Primary headline text (e.g., '这条最快', '适合 citywalk').

detail.description: Secondary detail text with specifics (e.g., '3.2km · 适合连续跑点').

isRouteLoading.description: Whether route data is currently being fetched.

routeError.description: Error message if route loading failed.

TransportInfo.description: Displays detailed transportation information between two points including mode, distance, duration, cost, and navigation steps.

distance.description: Distance of this transport segment in meters.

duration.description: Estimated duration of this segment in minutes.

cost.description: Estimated cost for this transport segment in RMB.

steps.description: Turn-by-turn navigation steps for the segment.

from.description: Starting point of the transport segment.

to.description: Destination point of the transport segment.

transfers.description: Number of transfers for transit mode.

walkingDistance.description: Walking distance in meters within this segment (e.g., to/from transit stations).

polyline.description: Encoded polyline string representing the route path on a map.

MapMarker.description: A point marker on a map representing an activity location with optional icon and color styling.

title.description: Display title shown on the marker tooltip or label.

icon.description: Icon identifier or URL for the marker. Use named icons from the design system (e.g., 'map-pin', 'restaurant', 'coffee').

color.description: Color of the marker icon, as a hex color code.

activityId.description: ID of the associated activity this marker represents.

isActive.description: Whether this marker is the currently focused/active one.

order.description: Display order in the itinerary sequence.

WarningBanner.description: An alert banner that displays warning or informational messages about the itinerary with configurable severity level and dismiss behavior.

message.description: The warning or informational message text to display.

severity.description: Severity level controlling the banner's visual style and urgency.

dismissible.description: Whether the user can dismiss/close the banner.

warningId.description: Unique identifier for this warning, used to track which warnings have been dismissed.

icon.description: Optional icon name to display alongside the message.

actionLabel.description: Optional label for a call-to-action button within the banner.

actionPrompt.description: Prompt text to send when the action button is clicked.

EmphasisBadge.description: A small visual badge used to emphasize or label items with a color, icon, and short text.

label.description: Short text label displayed inside the badge.

color.description: Background color of the badge, as a hex color code or CSS color name.

icon.description: Icon identifier from the design system to display alongside or instead of the label.

textColor.description: Text color of the badge, as a hex color code.

rounded.description: Whether the badge has fully rounded (pill) corners.

BudgetSlider.description: An interactive slider control for adjusting budget range, with configurable min, max, step, and current value.

min.description: Minimum value of the slider range.

max.description: Maximum value of the slider range.

step.description: Increment step size for the slider.

currentValue.description: Current selected value of the slider.

label.description: Display label shown above or beside the slider.

formatValue.description: Format pattern for displaying the value (e.g., '¥{value}', '{value}元').

showTicks.description: Whether to show tick marks along the slider track.

disabled.description: Whether the slider is disabled and non-interactive.

OptionVoting.description: An interactive voting component that allows users to select from multiple options, with a configurable maximum number of selections.

icon.description: Optional icon name for the option.

description.description: Optional longer description for the option.

voteCount.description: Current number of votes for this option.

maxSelections.description: Maximum number of options a user can select.

title.description: Title displayed above the voting options.

showResults.description: Whether to display vote counts alongside options.

multiMember.description: Whether this vote involves multiple team members with individual selections.

memberVotes.description: Per-member vote records when multiMember is true. Keys are member IDs, values are arrays of selected option IDs.

TimeAdjuster.description: An interactive time picker that allows adjusting the scheduled time of a specific activity within defined bounds.

activityId.description: ID of the activity whose time is being adjusted.

currentTime.description: Currently scheduled time in HH:MM format.

minTime.description: Earliest allowed time in HH:MM format.

maxTime.description: Latest allowed time in HH:MM format.

activityTitle.description: Title of the activity for display context.

showDuration.description: Whether to show the activity's duration alongside the time.

durationMinutes.description: Duration of the activity in minutes.

conflictWarnings.description: Warnings about time conflicts with adjacent activities.
